stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A music researcher found an old song written in a notebook with no recording.”?
options: After the performance, students discussed whether the decision was fair by today's standards.
Students listening to the performance realized that restoration is not always a simple return.
Students hearing the story learned that restoration does not always mean returning to the old condition exactly.
Months later, the old tree was gone, but the bench was always full of students.
